deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 39 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Power Supply Characteristics\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 39` output filtered to the `Power Supply Characteristics` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; treats a multi-field WORD as one printed value and omits reserved/enum/cross-state rules.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds per-bit and telemetry validation but lowers capability for inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; entry 668/2291 retains direct agent collection after operator target selection.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Validate every Type 39 Power Supply Characteristics subfield and reserved bit for each supply against the approved topology/state, with read-only telemetry corroboration and reboot persistence.
original_method: Length-check and decode the raw characteristics WORD into type, status, input-voltage switching, unplugged, present and hot-replace fields; enforce reserved zeros, check internal consistency and approved telemetry before/after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies expected per-supply characteristics and approves reboot; no unplug, removal, switching or load stimulus is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and Type 39 bit/enum definitions
Approved cross-field consistency and absent-supply policy
Read-only telemetry mapping and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only metadata/telemetry; never unplug, switch, remove or load-test a supply.
Preserve the raw WORD and decode each bit range; require reserved bits 15:14 zero.
Reject impossible combinations only under the approved presence/status model.
Stop on power/management failure; do not auto-retry reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Decode each raw WORD, validate reserved/enum ranges and cross-field consistency, correlate each supply with read-only telemetry and diff across reboot.
Report contradictions, mismatches or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-supply bitfield/state expectations and reboot plan.
Interpret platform-specific absent/hot-replace behavior and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot validate raw masks, reserved bits, enums or relationships among presence and status fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 39; emit identity, raw WORD, each decoded bit range, reserved result, approved consistency result, telemetry match and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The characteristics scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no physical power stimulus is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode bits 15:0 explicitly, enforce reserved zeros, validate enum encodings and test present/unplugged/status/hot-replace consistency against approved read-only telemetry across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and telemetry versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Power Supply Characteristics bitfield definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces one formatted grep with raw bit masks, reserved checks and cross-state validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects reserved-bit defects, invalid enums and internally contradictory power-state claims.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Dynamic telemetry may change during reboot; compare captures only after defined stable-state gates.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define expected status and hot-replace capabilities per topology, but cannot waive reserved-bit rules or authorize physical stimuli under this read-only case.
expected_evidence: Complete pre-reboot Type 39 handles/lengths and raw characteristics WORDs
Per-bit/reserved/consistency results with identity-bound read-only telemetry
Statement that no PSU was manipulated or loaded
Approved reboot/steady-state evidence and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names a real Type 39 bitfield; decomposing it preserves rather than changes the intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bitfield and telemetry comparison are fully automatable after approved state inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw per-bit, reserved, enum and cross-state coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-stimulus safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates expected-state readiness and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Exposes impossible presence/status combinations and reserved-bit defects hidden behind a friendly formatted summary.
independent_technical_reasoning: This WORD is a compact state/capability model, not a scalar; each encoded range and their logical relationships must be validated for the same supply identity.
